description: Move iCloud Mail messages (1–100 uids from apple_mail_search, one mailbox) to another mailbox: a path from apple_mail_list_mailboxes or an alias (inbox, archive, trash, junk, sent, drafts). Moving to trash is recoverable from Deleted Messages. Returns the new uids and verifies the messages left the source. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

destination.description: Where to move them: a mailbox path or alias (inbox, archive, trash, junk, sent, drafts).

mailbox.description: Mailbox the messages are in now (default inbox); path or alias.

uidValidity.description: The mailbox uidValidity returned alongside the uids. When given, the call is refused if the mailbox was renumbered since (an old uid could then name a different message).

uids.description: Message UIDs from apple_mail_search, all in the same mailbox (1–100).

name: apple_mail_move
title: Move iCloud Mail messages
